firmware.note: v0.1.6 (built 2026-11-19): the November fix. Schedule v3 is the embedded baseline (starts 2026-11-09, the cycle start) in the new slim table format, so November paints on-device and WiFi is a check-in again. Stubborn join (directed strongest, plain begin, then each remaining AP in one call; join record written once per call); raw disconnect reason on the setup page; date estimator measures actual sleep via the RTC clock instead of crediting the programmed duration; test-paint demo no longer marks itself rendered; post-sync repaint on the schedule path; version splash after a firmware or schedule change. The firmware channel reads only version + url; sha256/sizeBytes recorded for verification. httpUpdate fetches the APP image, not the merged flash image.
